summary: ADR-0097 — the smallest control-plane correction from the 075 preflight: a single audited, authorization-bound, auto-expiring backend ARM replaces the per-demo ~15-flag/7-worker ceremony WITHOUT lowering any gate. New CopierLiveArm model (additive migration 0014) bound to exactly one CopierLiveAuthorization with an immutable route snapshot, ENGAGED/DISENGAGED state, audit fields and expires_at capped at the authorization expiry; one engaged arm per route (partial-unique). New trade_copier/arm.py runtime evaluator fails closed on no-arm/expired/route-drift/owner-drift/duplicate/DB-error, auto-expiry by evaluation only. New copier_live_arm command: one-action ARM (re-runs the preflight fail-closed; requires ACTIVE unexpired sole authorization + staff approver + useful window + entry allowance + kill-switch clear + no conflicting arm + identity match + no in-flight job + master flat) and --disengage one-action return-to-OFF (no kill switch). copier_live_disarm extended: the emergency kill switch ALSO disengages all arms. reconcile_expired_copier_authorizations extended: marks expired arms DISENGAGED (audit; runtime already inert). require_engaged_arm threaded as the FINAL additional AND in admit_open_live and _live_lifecycle_preamble and re-checked UNDER the authorization lock in create_live_open_job (env gate is condition 1, route-exact arm is condition 2; never an OR bypass; kill switch always wins). A SAFETY-REDUCING containment close (after expiry / under kill switch) is EXEMPT from the arm so ADR-0083 containment is preserved. No LLM live-trading path. DARK/default-OFF; no deploy, no migration applied, no host contact, no secret, no flag enablement, no authorization, no broker order.
root_cause: The GFX-COPIER-REALTIME-BACKEND-AND-EMITTER-PREFLIGHT-075 preflight found the control plane had NO one-action ARM/DISARM: arming a demo required injecting ~15 COPIER_* env flags + running 7 single-pass workers and re-running them between trade actions, with no single audited record of 'armed for this authorization/route/window' and no automatic expiry/return-to-OFF.
change: 1) New backend/trade_copier/models.py CopierLiveArm + CopierLiveArmState (+ migration 0014_copier_live_arm, additive CreateModel). 2) New backend/trade_copier/arm.py (engaged_arm_for_authorization / require_engaged_arm / arm_summary — fail-closed evaluator with auto-expiry). 3) New backend/trade_copier/management/commands/copier_live_arm.py (one-action ARM + --disengage DISARM). 4) backend/trade_copier/management/commands/copier_live_disarm.py extended (kill switch also disengages arms). 5) backend/trade_copier/management/commands/reconcile_expired_copier_authorizations.py extended (disengage expired arms for audit). 6) backend/trade_copier/live_execution.py: require_engaged_arm as the final AND in admit_open_live + _live_lifecycle_preamble, under-lock re-check in create_live_open_job, and a containment exemption (close_only_after_expiry / kill_switch_close_only_containment closes are not arm-gated). 7) LIVE test suites updated to the env+arm contract via a shared attach_engaged_arm fixture (tests_live_copier/tests_immediate_dispatch/tests_live_lifecycle/tests_live_bridge_provision). 8) New backend/trade_copier/tests_copier_live_arm.py. adversarial_review.reviewer: independent agent (fresh context), 22 attack vectors; read arm.py + models.py + copier_live_arm.py + copier_live_disarm.py + reconcile command + the three live_execution.py admission threading points + the tests
adversarial_review.HIGH_vector12_containment_nullification: FIXED. Because the arm's expiry is capped at the authorization expiry and copier_live_disarm disengages arms, the arm as an UNCONDITIONAL final AND would have blocked the ADR-0083 safety-reducing CLOSE of an already-open live position AFTER the entry window expired (close_only_after_expiry) or WHILE the kill switch is engaged (contain_on_kill_switch) — blocking the close is the UNSAFE direction (exposure stranded). Fix: _live_lifecycle_preamble now EXEMPTS a containment close (op in CLOSE_OPS AND window_reason=='close_only_after_expiry' OR killswitch_reason=='kill_switch_close_only_containment') from the arm requirement; the authorization + per-op close authority + the explicit policy flag remain the sole authority; a MODIFY is never exempt and OPEN entry is always arm-gated. Regression: the two containment tests were corrected to the production invariant (arm expires with the authz / is disengaged by the kill switch) and assert the close is admitted with NO live arm; new test_in_window_close_requires_arm asserts a normal in-window close with the arm disengaged fails closed no_live_arm.
adversarial_review.LOW_vector16_concurrent_arm_toctou: FIXED. The idempotency check was moved INSIDE the atomic block, after the authorization select_for_update, so two concurrent ARM calls for the same authorization serialize on the authz row and the second returns the first's arm (no duplicate, no IntegrityError race).
adversarial_review.LOW_vector7_lifecycle_underlock_arm_rech: DOCUMENTED (residual, bounded). create_live_open_job re-checks the arm under the authorization lock; the lifecycle creators re-run the full admission (ending in the arm) on the select_for_update'd replication but do not re-check the arm a second time inside _relock_live_authz_for_lifecycle. A soft DISARM committing in the few-statement window between that admission and the job INSERT would not be seen for MODIFY/CLOSE (OPEN would catch it). The DURABLE kill switch — the emergency stop — IS re-checked under the lock, and a close is exposure-reducing, so the residual is a narrow, safe-direction timing gap; the next event re-evaluates. Not an open hole.
adversarial_review.safe_vectors: 18/22 SAFE: replay/reuse, authorization substitution, cross-tenant/route, symbol substitution, stale authz, expiry race, duplicate engaged rows, kill-switch bypass, env-gate bypass, op-authority escalation, stale-ENGAGED-after-expiry, late-HTTP/UNKNOWN, one-order allowance race, DB failure (fail closed), audit/non-staff (ARM requires is_staff), log/secret leakage (none to leak), misleading-OFF (DISARM states host admission is separate), preflight bypass (fails closed on any backend blocker; host-probe items correctly separate), idempotency. No LIVE order path omits require_engaged_arm.

truthfulness_note: The backend arm state is distinct from Windows host admission. An engaged CopierLiveArm is a backend control-plane fact only; it does NOT set or imply MT5_ALLOW_LIVE on the follower bridge. Backend DISARM (copier_live_arm --disengage) returns the backend gates to OFF but does NOT restore host admission — the signed restore_copier_bridge_execution_off is a separate operator step. The command outputs state this explicitly; no complete system-wide OFF is claimed from the arm row alone.
